entities.summary: Jonathan Patrick Sigalet is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman currently playing for Brynäs IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was selected by the Boston Bruins in the fourth round of the 2005 NHL Entry Draft.
